documents.title: Autumn League 2025 sailing instructions
documents.why: 6.1 and 6.2 A and B place the offshore and inshore starting areas and define their starting lines, which the cards do not; 6.1 C and 6.2 C say the windward mark Z is laid to windward of the line and is the first mark of every fixed-mark course.

documents.title: Autumn League 2025, change to sailing instructions no. 2
documents.why: The current definition of the Howth Sound finishing line for classes 4 and 5 and the Howth 17s on two-race days, replacing change no. 1's. Changes no. 1 and no. 3 are not kept: no. 1 is superseded in full by this one, and no. 3 changes only the schedule and the windward/leeward appendix, which is not on a card.

variation.why: Mid-series: the league is sailed from 13 September to 11 October 2025. Card pages work out the magnetic variation for this date at the middle of the marks from the World Magnetic Model; the variation changes by about a tenth of a degree a year here, so any day of the series gives the same figure.
